headline: Bolt.new reaches $40M ARR in 5 months
summary: The AI-powered development tool built on Rails hits explosive growth, becoming one of the fastest-growing Ruby startups ever.

headline: Rails 8 officially released with major performance improvements
summary: The latest version of Ruby on Rails brings Solid Queue, Solid Cache, and significant speed improvements out of the box.

headline: Gusto reportedly exploring 2026 IPO
summary: The payroll giant built on Rails is considering going public, which would be a landmark moment for the Ruby ecosystem.

headline: SF Ruby Conference 2025 breaks attendance records
summary: Over 450 Rubyists gathered at Fort Mason for the largest Ruby conference on the West Coast, featuring talks from Matz and DHH.

headline: Thatch raises $38M Series A for health benefits platform
summary: The Ruby-powered startup modernizing health benefits for startups secures major funding round led by Andreessen Horowitz.

headline: Ubicloud open sources its Ruby-based cloud platform
summary: The AWS alternative makes its control plane code available to the community, built primarily in Ruby.

headline: Ruby ranks in top 5 most loved languages in 2025 survey
summary: The Pragmatic Engineer survey shows Ruby developers remain among the happiest, with strong job satisfaction scores.

headline: NexHealth reaches unicorn status with $1B+ valuation
summary: The healthcare API platform built on Rails joins the unicorn club after explosive growth in the healthtech sector.
